newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BEVAN AND HAYDEN SMASH 98 IN 11 OVERS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BEVAN AND HAYDEN SMASH 98 IN 11 OVERS.

text.p: Middle order pair Michael Bevan and Matthew Hayden hammered 98 off 11 overs as Australia punished the Transvaal Invitation XI bowling on Tuesday.
Australia scored 261 for seven from their 45 overs in a one-day match at the Elkah Stadium.
Mark Taylor won the toss and after the early loss of Greg Blewett (6), runs flowed freely for the touring team.
Matthew Elliott, who hit 69 from 91 balls with five fours and two sixes, put on 117 for the second wicket with Justin Langer who made 63 off 82 balls with four fours and a six.
Bevan (49) and Hayden (47) lifted the tempo in their 98-run partnership for the fourth wicket before medium pacer Andrew Hall initiated a late collapse.
Hall removed Bevan, Hayden and Mark Waugh for a first ball duck in his last over, the 44th of the innings.
With Taylor going for two in the final over, four wickets fell for four runs in nine balls.
